name: The Road to Glory
overview: When the fallen princess Wen Yu seeks help to reclaim her kingdom, the street-smart Xiao Li unexpectedly rescues her. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to defeat traitors and restore her throne. Along the way, Xiao Li rises from rogue to powerful warlord, and their bond deepens—but as they climb the ladder of power, love and ambition collide, testing their loyalty and hearts.
